notes.note: Reviewed for this fix round (keyword sweep: retryable, refusal codes, queue/unsent, SendTurnRefused, starting/reattach, then read each hit): ACP sendTurn now waits up to 60s for its session's start; a failed start refuses definitively with its reason; an outwaited start refuses with the new retryable code provider_session_starting, which orchestration-service forwards as retryable and the UI queue/immediate-send paths keep queued and redrain; resume falls back to load only on method-not-found. This document makes no claim about these refusals, codes or the ACP start window; its statements remain accurate.
